summary: Phase 11 bug-fix verification — 11/11 backend tests PASS (100%). Covers P0 friend-request Web→Telegram (B-N00), orphan cleanup (B-N00b), single /logout endpoint with JWT revocation (B-N01), /auth/config smoke (B-N02), no-duplicate user on register (B-N03), referral_code linkage (B-N04), last_login_ip/ua on register (B-N05), auto verification email (B-N06), server-side strip() of names (B-N07), and anonymous /email/verify returning access_token+user (B-N08). All previously reported deviations resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: send_friend_request now validates sender's user_settings BEFORE creating the row (server.py:15237-15246) — eliminates root cause of P0 (phantom Web sender producing silent orphan).
get_friend_requests has correct orphan auto-cleanup scope (only OTHER side checked against users_map; caller's own settings need not be in the map). Confirmed legit requests survive multiple GETs.
Single POST /api/auth/logout in OpenAPI (no duplicate route). Revoked JWT yields 401 on retry — confirmed end-to-end.
Anonymous /email/verify returns access_token+user (B-N08) while authenticated call still returns success-only — branch logic at auth_routes.py:2728 is correct.
Referral linkage: referrer.invited_count is properly incremented and referee.user_settings.referred_by stores referrer's effective tid — confirmed via DB inspection.
Minor nit (carried over from iteration_2, not retested here): POST /api/auth/password/change keeps current session active by design — main agent already aware.
test_credentials: phase11_<hex>@test.com / Test1234 created on the fly. X-Forwarded-For randomised to bypass register-email 5/hr/IP limit. SMTP DEV → /app/logs/emails.log; tokens extracted via regex [?&]token=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+).
seed_data_creation: ~7 phase11_* email users created; orphan-cleanup test seeded a fake recipient tid=77777777777777 and phantom sender tid=88888888888888 then deleted both; friend-request P0 test seeded TG recipient tid=765963392 (since the real one is not present in this preview DB) and removed it after the test. End-of-module fixture deletes all phase11_* users + their pseudo-tid user_settings + auth_tokens + friend_requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public ingress https://rudn-auth-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com is reachable but slow/flaky — first request often times out at 10s. Tests default to http://localhost:8001 (USE_LOCAL=1). Override via USE_LOCAL=0 env var. DB stores users.uid as STRING (despite generated by int sequencer); use string keys for lookups. user_settings stores `referred_by` (not on users doc) — it holds the referrer's effective telegram_id (real or pseudo_tid). pseudo_tid_from_uid(uid) = 10_000_000_000 + int(uid).
rca of the issue: Original P0: Web user (whose pseudo_tid is 10_000_000_000 + uid) clicked 'Send friend request' on a Public Profile page. Frontend used currentUser.id (Mongo doc id) instead of currentUser's effective telegram_id → backend created friend_request row with bogus from_telegram_id that had no matching user_settings → get_friend_requests filtered it out (no sender in users_map) → recipient never saw it. Two-part fix verified: (1) frontend now sends getEffectiveTid(currentUser) which returns telegram_id || pseudo_tid (not tested here per scope), (2) backend send_friend_request now rejects phantom senders early with 400 'Войдите в аккаунт...' AND get_friend_requests auto-deletes any pre-existing orphan rows on next fetch. Both backend halves verified by tests test_phantom_sender_rejected, test_web_user_to_telegram_user_arrives, test_orphan_cleanup_removes_phantom_row.
